The widow '''Gervruche''' was the wife of [[Gervruche]], a [[Special Projects Consultant]] for the [[Imperial Correctional Facilities Ministry]]. When Gervruche was killed, [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Chawkroft]] assumed his position at the Ministry and relayed the condolences of [[Ilm Vaz-Weplinn]], Gervruche's [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] colleague to her. Gervruche's widow expressed her thanks to Chawkroft, which Chawkroft later communicated to Vaz-Weplinn.<ref name="HSCS" />
